_about: Reviewer spec for ju26-issue-2234. v0: written by the reviewer (human-curated); v1: generated by the reviewer model from requirement + diff + ledger. Every claim here must point at ledger tests or facts; anything that doesn't is listed as hearsay.

blind_intent: Requirement #2234 says analyzer diagnostics stopped being reported for [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] types in 3.1.1. A fix should make the analyzer report MsgPack00x diagnostics for suppressed types again, and nothing else should change.

behavior_changes.title: Analyzer no longer crashes on duplicate or mixed keys
behavior_changes.link_why: Real bug, but not the one in #2234: the tests that prove it are about duplicate/mixed keys, not SuppressSourceGeneration.

question.prompt: Two members share Key(0). What should the analyzer report?

options.text: MsgPack005, and an analyzer crash (AD0001) is acceptable

question.reveal_text: Before the PR: MsgPack005 and then the analyzer crashes (AD0001: ArgumentException 'An item with the same key has already been added'), so later diagnostics in that type are lost. After the PR: MsgPack005 only, no crash.

behavior_changes.title: Generator now emits a formatter that silently keeps the first of two duplicate-key members
behavior_changes.link_why: Not mentioned by the requirement, the agent's tests or the README. Changes the wire format a user gets if MsgPack005 is downgraded from error.

question.prompt: A project downgrades MsgPack005 to a warning. What should the generated formatter for Foo do?

options.text: Generate nothing for Foo; the build should not get a formatter for an invalid contract
Generator fails loudly (as before the PR)

question.reveal_text: Before the PR: the generator throws, so no formatter is produced. After the PR: a formatter is generated that writes only First. Second is never serialized, and nothing at runtime says so.

behavior_changes.title: Generator skips a member whose key kind doesn't match (int vs string)
behavior_changes.link_why: Same `continue` added in two places in TypeCollector; not in the requirement.

question.prompt: Keys mix int and string (MsgPack005 downgraded). What should the generated formatter do?

options.text: Generator fails loudly (as before the PR)

question.reveal_text: Before the PR: the generator throws (InvalidOperationException: Nullable object must have a value). After the PR: First is serialized and Second is skipped.

refusals.why: The regression described in #2234 (commit 1a74a620, v3.1.0→v3.1.1) is not in this code's history, and every agent test that claims to check SuppressSourceGeneration behavior already passes on the base commit. There is nothing here to prove the issue was fixed, because it was never broken in this history.

refusals.topic: Is silently dropping a duplicate-key member an acceptable contract?
refusals.why: A choice about the serialization contract and user data; the requirement says nothing about it. An AI must not approve a wire-format choice by default.
